name: Dani
title: IT Student & Frontend Developer
bio: Szia! I'm a passionate Hungarian IT student who loves building beautiful, performant web experiences. From crafting pixel-perfect UIs to diving deep into backend logic, I bring ideas to life with clean code and creative solutions.
bioExtended: When I'm not coding, you'll find me gaming, listening to lo-fi beats, or debugging something I shouldn't have touched in the first place. I believe great software is a blend of engineering and art — and I'm here to master both.

funFacts.back: I've sunk 2,000+ hours into strategy games. Chess taught me to think 5 moves ahead — in code too.
My daily fuel is 3 cups of strong Hungarian coffee. Instant is not coffee. Fight me.
Born and raised in Hungary. We invented the Rubik's Cube, the ballpoint pen, and apparently me.
Peak productivity: 11 PM – 3 AM. My best code gets written when the world is asleep.
